instructions.content: NEVER invent or infer design tokens that don't exist in source code
NEVER expand one brand colour into a full palette; document only the hardcoded values found
NEVER generate the reference sheet before reading actual CSS/config files
NEVER leave sections empty without a TBD marker; write `TBD — not yet defined`
NEVER abort or refuse because the codebase is sparse; produce the sheet with TBD markers
NEVER use non-copy-pasteable code examples in the reference sheet; use actual tokens from source
NEVER use a generic description in the companion enforcement skill; name the project
NEVER place the companion enforcement skill under `docs/`; it lives in the project skills directory
NEVER leave `{PROJECT_NAME}` or `{TOKEN_*}` template placeholders in generated output
NEVER skip the final confirmation report listing populated sections and TBD items
Discover design tokens by searching CSS for custom properties, `@theme`, `@font-face` and `@import`
Inspect 3 to 5 representative components before writing
Check dark mode and accessibility patterns
Fill the structured scratchpad `templates/skill-output.yaml`, validated against the JSON schema, before any markdown
Review the populated scratchpad for TBD or null values before generating the final docs
Generate `docs/design/design-reference.md` covering all 12 sections from the template
Validate the scratchpad against `schemas/design-reference.schema.json` and report populated sections and TBD items
Do not use the skill for projects with no CSS source files, for updating an existing sheet, or for a generic design system template
